info.title: M03 Central Timetable and Calendar — PROPOSED, NOT FROZEN
info.description: Paths are relative to /api/v1. Every write body is closed: an unknown field is 422. Collections return items and next_cursor; there is no offset paging. Civil dates are Asia/Kolkata; instants are UTC.

session.name: sessionid
session.description: Server-derived. M01 owns real login; the standalone profile derives a fixed synthetic persona on loopback instead, and real authentication integration stays pending.

CalendarDTO.description: A dated range of calendar answers.

CalendarDayDTO.description: Whether one date is a teaching day, and why not when it is not.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

kinds.description: Every exception in force on the date. An exam day is a teaching day; a holiday is not.

CalendarExceptionDTO.description: One school-authored exception to the weekly pattern.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

CalendarExceptionRequest.description: Record one exception to the weekly pattern.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

ConflictDTO.description: One detected conflict. 'blocking' true means publish refuses while it stands.

CreateTimetableRequest.description: Create a draft revision. Never creates a published one: publication is a separate, authorised transition.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The frozen error body. M03 adds no field to it; only message_key values are module-specific.

PeriodSessionDTO.description: One dated teaching period. Its identity is stable across timetable revisions, so attendance written against it reconciles after a republish.

slot_code.description: The school's own short code for a period, e.g. 'P1'. School-authored; this module supplies no period naming convention.

starts_at_local.description: Wall-clock time at the school (Asia/Kolkata). Never a UTC instant.

ends_at_local.description: Wall-clock time at the school (Asia/Kolkata). Never a UTC instant.

cancellation_reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

timetable_version.description: Aggregate version of the timetable that produced this session. Paired with timetable_id so a consumer can name the exact revision.

PeriodTemplateDTO.description: One bell-time slot on one weekday, owned by a timetable version. Bell times can change between revisions, so the template belongs to the version rather than to the school.

slot_code.description: The school's own short code for a period, e.g. 'P1'. School-authored; this module supplies no period naming convention.

starts_at_local.description: Wall-clock time at the school (Asia/Kolkata). Never a UTC instant.

ends_at_local.description: Wall-clock time at the school (Asia/Kolkata). Never a UTC instant.

PeriodTemplateRequest.description: One bell-time row in a draft grid.

slot_code.description: The school's own short code for a period, e.g. 'P1'. School-authored; this module supplies no period naming convention.

starts_at_local.description: Wall-clock time at the school (Asia/Kolkata). Never a UTC instant.

ends_at_local.description: Wall-clock time at the school (Asia/Kolkata). Never a UTC instant.

PublishRequest.description: Publish the draft the caller last read.

PublishResultDTO.description: The outcome of publishing a draft.

ReplaceTimetableRequest.description: Replace a draft's whole grid under optimistic locking. The editor saves a week, not a cell, so one transaction either takes the grid or refuses it.

SectionDayDTO.description: The effective schedule for one section on one date, with the calendar answer that produced it.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

SessionCancellationRequest.description: Cancel or restore one dated period without touching the recurring schedule.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

expected_version.description: The cancellation record's version. Null on the first cancellation of a session, which has no record yet.

SlotDTO.description: One recurring teaching assignment: this section takes this subject from this teacher in this period, every week the version is effective.

slot_code.description: The school's own short code for a period, e.g. 'P1'. School-authored; this module supplies no period naming convention.

room_code.description: PROPOSED. Free text, school-authored. There is no Room aggregate and no room conflict detection: rooms were not among the owned records, so modelling them would widen the module.

SlotRequest.description: One cell in a draft grid. The period is named by weekday and slot code, not by id, so a grid can be sent before its period rows have ids.

slot_code.description: The school's own short code for a period, e.g. 'P1'. School-authored; this module supplies no period naming convention.

StudentDayDTO.description: One pupil's dated schedule, resolved through their section.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

StudentSessionDTO.description: One session as a pupil sees it. 'enrolled' comes from the subject-filtered roster, so a pupil who does not take the subject sees a free period rather than a lesson they must attend.

SubstitutionDTO.description: An explicit dated replacement for one period. It authorises the substitute for that session only, until valid_until.

SubstitutionRequest.description: Assign a substitute to one dated period.

TeacherDayDTO.description: One teacher's dated schedule: periods they are assigned to, plus periods they are substituting on that date.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

TeacherSlotDTO.description: One period a teacher teaches on a named date.

TeacherSlotPage.description: Teacher periods in the requested range, earliest first.

TeacherUnavailableDTO.description: A half-open UTC interval during which a staff member cannot teach.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

TeacherUnavailableRequest.description: Record a staff member's unavailability as a half-open UTC interval.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

TeachingAuthorityDTO.description: The trusted fact M04 attendance combines with Access policy: who may record attendance for one dated period, and until when.

eligible_for_attendance.description: False on a holiday, for a cancelled session, and for a date outside every published effective range.

TimetableSummaryDTO.description: A timetable version without its grid, for listing.

TimetableVersionDTO.description: One dated revision of the central timetable. Periods and slots are its children and are replaced as a whole while it is a draft.

UpdateCalendarExceptionRequest.description: Amend or withdraw an exception. Withdrawn rather than deleted: a published schedule already referred to it.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

UpdateSubstitutionRequest.description: Withdraw a substitution. Withdrawn rather than deleted: attendance may already cite it.

UpdateTeacherUnavailableRequest.description: Amend or withdraw an unavailability interval.

reason_key.description: Stable message key the frontend renders in English or Malayalam. Never user-facing prose.

ValidationReportDTO.description: The result of validating a draft. An empty list means publish would be accepted at this moment; it is not a reservation.
